title: BeeBot state store
description: Startup schema for both record types; missing or invalid means every write is refused.

work_name.description: Filename-safe work name, unique together with cwd; keeps work_state_path inside states/.

timestamp.description: Fixed-width ISO-8601 UTC seconds ending in 'Z'; lexical order is chronological.

index_row.description: One code-written row of states/index.jsonl: the recall fields needed without opening a work file.

cwd.description: Required, immutable key half: the real work directory from which its bucket is derived.

work_name.description: Unique together with `cwd`. That pair is a cross-record invariant this schema cannot express; `validate` enforces it.

short_description.description: One-line recall summary, avoiding work-file reads during search.

updated.description: Server-assigned, strictly monotonic update time and stale-write token.

completion.description: The one-bit fact recall filters on. Not `current_status`, which is prose.

work_state_path.description: Stored '<bucket>/<work_name>.json' path relative to states/, retained for compatibility if bucket naming changes. resolve_in_store enforces containment.

work_file.description: Agent-written content; the index row owns identity, location, and time.

description.description: What the work is and what done looks like.

prior_actions.description: Brief attempts and outcomes, especially dead ends. Replaces the whole list.

next_steps.description: What to do next. Replaces the whole list.

blockers.description: What is stopping progress. Replaces the whole list; normally empty.

artifacts.description: Durable references only; referenced content lives elsewhere.

item.description: Any durable reference -- a path, link, commit, or job ID.

note.description: What it is and why it matters.

final_learnings.description: Optional end-of-work lessons for similar work; prior_actions serves this work's successor.
